'''Ninan''' was an [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] and [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] who served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following the Confederacy's defeat at the conclusion of the conflict in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Ninan accompanied the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] [[Sa Nalaor/Legends|''Sa Nalaor'']] as it attempted to flee to the outskirts of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in order to escape from the [[Declaration of a New Order|newly-formed]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After being crippled by fire from pursuing Imperial [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]], the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] crash-landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]], leaving Ninan and the surviving crew stranded on the world. The Separatists established a base, known as [[the Retreat]], in which to shelter from Cholganna's hostile wildlife, and Ninan was put in charge of running the facility's garage. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the survivors were yet to be rescued, and Ninan had began to suffer from the onset of old age. With his movements limited, he rarely left the garage, and he was assisted in his duties by several other survivors and by the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-6N]].
